summary: Nebius Group N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing a strategic partnership with Palantir Technologies. Under the agreement, Palantir named Nebius its preferred sovereign AI infrastructure partner, intending to integrate Nebius compute and inference into Palantir's perimeter for commercial customers. No financial terms, ownership stakes, or share prices were disclosed. The filing describes a commercial collaboration, not a special situation transaction. It is a routine partnership announcement with no M&A, tender, or restructuring elements. What to watch: potential future agreements or capacity deployment, but no transactional risk-arb angle.
